lastGame.title: Bills 23, Vikings 6
stats: Josh Allen: 21-of-31, 234 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 25-yard TD pass to Keleki Latu (Latu's first career TD)
James Cook: 31 carries, 107 yards, 1 rushing TD (5 yards)
Tyler Bass: 3 field goals (39, 25 and 52 yards)
Defense: 3 turnovers, 2 INTs (Dorian Williams, Terrel Bernard); Vikings 0-for-7 on third down
Carson Wentz: 8-of-25, 81 yards, 2 INTs for Minnesota

news.b: Starting right tackle Spencer Brown (ankle) is doubtful after missing Thursday and Friday practice. Tylan Grable would likely start if Brown can't go.

CB Christian Benford (wrist), S Sam Franklin Jr. (shoulder), DB Jordan Hancock (hamstring) and WR Tyrell Shavers (knee) are questionable. Dion Dawkins, Alec Anderson, Connor McGovern and Dalton Kincaid practiced fully and have no designation.
Joe Brady says trade-deadline pickup Amani Hooker, a safety acquired from Tennessee, will play at the Jets, though his role and snap count are still to be decided.

The Jets list Garrett Wilson (concussion) as questionable but expect him to clear protocol. Omar Cooper Jr. and seven other Jets are questionable; LB Trevin Wallace (groin) is out. Kickoff Sunday 1 p.m. ET on CBS.

source: buffalobills.com injury report and Hooker story (Nov 13), newyorkjets.com Friday injury report (Nov 13), Fox Sports standings (Nov 14), ESPN TNF result (Nov 12).
